Privacy Policy

This is probably the shortest privacy policy you've ever read.

I don't run any analytics software, don't set any cookies, I don't run any JavaScript. This is a 100% static site handcrafted in HTML and CSS. This site will not be monetized and it will not serve ads. This is my little corner of the internet that I'd like to share with you.

I do keep general access logs that I periodically review on the server. This includes the following details:

  • Anonymized IP Address
  • Request Timestamp
  • Request Method
  • Request URL
  • User-Agent
  • Response Code
  • Bytes Served

None of this data is used for user tracking or analytics, it is purely used for ensuring the server remains healthy and to allow me to block bad traffic if necessary. These logs are kept for 1 week to allow time for analysis in the event of malicious activity. After 1 week, they are automatically deleted.
